missions.name: The Black Hooded Hatchet
missions.description: Locate the man in black clothes with a hatchet who is terrorizing your village.

missions.name: Find the Cult's Hideout
missions.description: Find out where the cult's hideout is.  Mizon said it was far away from him.

missions.name: Get Hambone Apples
missions.description: Get 6 apples and give them to Hambone who is poor and hungry.

missions.name: Get Brody a Garbage Can Lid
missions.description: Get Brody the shield he always wanted, a garbage can lid.

missions.name: Get Jim Sanders Some Gear
missions.description: Get Jim Sanders a sickle because he needs some new gear to be stronger.

missions.name: Give Cleveland His Letter
missions.description: Give Cleveland in Mushroom Village, his letter from Arny.

missions.name: Look Like a Black Hood
missions.description: Look like a Black Hooded cult member so you can trick Fredward.

missions.name: Get Gordon Watermelon
missions.description: Gordon is trying to start a watermelon farm.  Get him 6 watermelon to help him.

missions.name: Get Pablo a Monster Skull
missions.description: Get Pablo the skull of a monster.  Maybe some enemies will drop them?

missions.name: Show Joshua All Enemies
missions.description: Fill your Hero-pedia up with all enemies info then report back to Joshua.

missions.name: Get Scarlet a Hockey Mask
missions.description: Get Scarlet a hockey mask so she can look scarier. Maybe a monster will drop one?

missions.name: Look Like the Lost Warrior
missions.description: Trick Clark into thinking you're the lost warrior. His clues are said to be written in stone.

missions.name: Solve Jimmy's Puzzle
missions.description: Jimmy drew some graffiti of items on objects throughout the map. Wear the items Jimmy drew.

requirement.description: Equip weapon matching your username length

missions.name: Complete Albert's Puzzle
missions.description: Talk to Albert to get clues on what the special helmet he wants you to wear is.

requirement.description: Say secret phrase based on your level in chat near Albert

missions.name: Get Cassie Pumpkin Helmets
missions.description: Cassie thinks pumpkin helmets are cool.  Get her two pumpkin helmets.

missions.name: Complete Billbert's Puzzle
missions.description: Talk to Billbert to get clues on what the special helmet he wants you to wear is.

requirement.description: Match hair style to riddle hint

missions.name: Collect 4 Pets
missions.description: Complete Wilson's triple dog dare and own 4 pets.  Have 4 pets on you at once to finish.

missions.name: Ride a Pet
missions.description: Use a pet as a mount and ride it.  Cheer Patrick up and show him you are riding one.

missions.name: Catch Every Fish
missions.description: Catch every type of fish in your Heropedia and report back to Lamar.

missions.name: Solve Philbert's Puzzle
missions.description: Complete Philbert's puzzle as his last dying wish for fun.

requirement.description: Wear red shirt (if name.length <= 10) or white shirt (if name.length > 10)

missions.name: Reach High Energy Level
missions.description: Reach an energy level of at least 9,000 to prove to Derek that you are powerful.
